payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerates factor triples of n by nested loops over small divisors, generates all assignments to (A-1,B-2,C-2) to compute min/max original volume.
payload.rationale: Solution brute-forces possible (A-1,B-2,C-2) by iterating i and j up to limits, checks if i*j divides n, then computes three permutations of factor assignment. This is a complete search over factor triples, specifically enumerating permutations.
